import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/training_9.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and types
        # Target schema: ['admit': int, 'gre': int, 'gpa': float, 'prestige': int]
        df = df[['admit', 'gre', 'gpa', 'prestige']].copy()
        df['admit'] = df['admit'].astype(int)
        df['gre'] = df['gre'].astype(int)
        df['gpa'] = df['gpa'].astype(float)
        df['prestige'] = df['prestige'].astype(int)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
    # we can concatenate (union) all source tables vertically.
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_64/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
